programme.title: The Host
programme.desc: From Stephenie Meyer, the creator of the worldwide phenomenon The Twilight Saga, comes this daring and romantic thriller based on the bestselling novel. When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world. The Host is a passionate and powerful epic love story.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp

programme.title: Tragedy Girls
programme.desc: A twist on the slasher genre, following two death-obsessed teenage girls who use their online show about real-life tragedies to send their small mid-western town into a frenzy, and cement their legacy as modern horror legends.

programme.title: Take Me Home Tonight
programme.desc: It's the late 1980s, when Wall Street is riding high, and it seems as if the entire country is cashing in on the bumper profits. Disgusted with the materialism that surrounds him, Matt Franklin, a brilliant young MIT graduate, has walked out on his well-paid position at a local lab and taken a low-level job as a video clerk, much to his father Bill's consternation. And the crises keep piling up in Matt's life. His best buddy Barry has just gotten fired from his job, his brainy sister Wendy is getting hitched to her vapid boyfriend Kyle, and the gorgeous Tori Frederking, long-time object of Matt's unattainable adoration, is suddenly back in the picture. Now, on one wild, woolly and irresponsible evening, everything is coming to a head, with explosive results.

programme.title: Marlowe
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1930. A street-wise, down on his luck detective, Philip Marlowe, is hired to find the ex-lover of a glamorous heiress, daughter of a well-known movie star. The disappearance unearths a web of lies, and soon Marlowe is involved in a dangerous, deadly investigation where everyone involved has something to hide.

Jerry doesn't believe the police arrested the right man; he discovers this is the third incident in the area in the recent past with victims young, blond, pretty, and small for their age.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: "Upon hearing of his brother's death, a man named Shen returns to his old stomping grounds to find the men responsible and take justice into his own hands. He learns that a biker named Cobra and his ferocious gang, The Midnight Squad, were the ones responsible ... but to get anywhere close to them, he must enter the dark, turbulent realm of underground motorcycle racing. Enlisting the aid of a drag racing champion-turned-mechanic, Shen must compete in the high-stakes races where he will have one chance to confront Cobra. But when Shen's plan is revealed, he must battle both on the streets and in the ring to obtain his final revenge. Featuring hip-hop legend DMX (Belly, Romeo Must Die), Fast Vengeance is a high-octane action thriller with style — and rubber — to burn.".

programme.desc: A Los Angeles native (Cheech Marin) is rounded up by mistake with illegal aliens and dumped south of the border.

programme.title: Slap Shot
programme.desc: A minor-league hockey team makes sports history when its members decide to spruce up the team's image by playing dirty.","large":"In the small New England town of Charlestown, the local mill is about to lay off 10,000 workers. The town's minor league hockey team, the Charlestown Chiefs, is doing no better. After years of failure, this will be the team's last season. Exasperated player and coach Reggie Dunlop (Paul Newman) lets the club's recent acquisitions, the Hanson Brothers, play. The brothers' actively violent and thuggish style of play excites the fans. Dunlop retools the team, using violence to draw big crowds.

programme.title: For Love of the Game
programme.desc: An aging pitcher (Kevin Costner) learns that he will soon lose his girlfriend (Kelly Preston) and his spot with the Detroit Tigers.","large":"Forty-year-old pitcher Billy Chapel (Kevin Costner) is practically a dinosaur by professional baseball standards, fast approaching the end of his career. But, as Chapel stands on the mound pitching the game of his life, his thoughts don't turn to his prized history in sports, but rather return again and again to his tumultuous relationship with Jane Aubrey (Kelly Preston), a single mom who has stood at his side through the good and the bad but is now on the verge of leaving him.

programme.title: The Babe
programme.desc: Abandoned as a boy, George Herman Ruth (John Goodman) grows up to be a larger-than-life baseball hero.","large":"George Herman "Babe" Ruth (John Goodman) grows from a troubled boy who was sent to an orphanage to one of the most successful baseball players on record. Babe first becomes a power hitter and pitcher for the Boston Red Sox. After a falling-out with Red Sox owner Harry Frazee (Peter Donat), Babe is sold to the New York Yankees. He is idolized in New York, setting a record for home runs, as well as creating dramatic moments like hitting two homers for a sick boy in the hospital.

programme.title: The Best of Times
programme.desc: Two men (Robin Williams, Kurt Russell) get to replay a high-school football game 16 years after one dropped the other's touchdown pass.","large":"Married banker Jack Dundee (Robin Williams) has lived his life regretting a botched play he made in a high school football game. His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Richard Pryor) takes handicapped orphans and their teacher (Cicely Tyson) from Philadelphia to Washington state by bus.","large":"Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: A priest (Donald Pleasence) summons a professor (Victor Wong) to an old church to see a canister of liquid Satan.","large":"Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
programme.desc: Crime lord Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake) awakens from a coma and again destroys disfigured Darkman's (Arnold Vosloo) liquid-skin laboratory.","large":"Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake), who gave him the hideous burns that transformed him into his alter ego, Darkman. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: Circumstantial evidence holds an innocent Londoner (Jon Finch) for the work of a rapist who strangles his victims with neckties.","large":"London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
programme.desc: A Los Angeles policeman (Sylvester Stallone) has his little mother (Estelle Getty) from New Jersey for a partner, whether he likes it or not.","large":"Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case.

programme.title: Streets of Fire
programme.desc: A rock star's (Diane Lane) ex-lover (Michael Paré) leads a rescue after urban bikers kidnap her from the stage.","large":"Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: An ex-'60s-radical computer hacker (Robert Redford) and his company are tapped for a shady black-box job.","large":"Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.","large":"Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: A trucker with a vehicular manslaughter conviction agrees to drive a suspicious shipment for his boss.","large":"An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: A jailed IRA operative (Richard Gere) helps the FBI track a masterful assassin (Bruce Willis) about to perform a political killing.","large":"During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: An FBI renegade (Bruce Willis) tries to stop his nemesis (Alec Baldwin) from killing an autistic boy (Miko Hughes) who cracked a government code.","large":""Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: An ex-cop (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must protect a woman chosen by Satan (Gabriel Byrne) to be the mother of the Antichrist.","large":"With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.sub-title: Anna and the Thresher Sharks (The Philippines)
programme.desc: On the island of Malapascua in the Philippines, Anna Oposa and her team are working with local fisherman to create a nature reserve where thresher sharks can thrive. These sharks are famous for their long tails which they use to whip and stun their prey. Every day, pelagic thresher sharks head to Monad Shoal, a sunken island just off the coast of Malapascua, where other fish “clean” them of their external parasites. This remarkable sight is popular with divers but the numbers of thresher sharks are dwindling and Anna is spearheading the campaign to protect this incredible species in the Philippines.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Lorane is a young scientist dedicated to building shelters in the Franco-Swiss mountains for orphaned baby lynx, one of Europe's last great feline species and predators. Lynx are critical to the preservation and growth of Europe's habitats, playing a key role in the wider eco-system. Lorane's passion and commitment to save every last lynx teaches valuable lessons about how animals and humans can learn to live side by side.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: The decline of the pangolin is staggering. Virtually exterminated from all over Asia, it still survives in Africa. But the Asian market demands ever increasing quantities, the value of its scales reaching disproportionate prices. A new symbol of human greed, the animal will not last long. Despite this dire fate, Tessa wants to believe in another future for the pangolin. She joined forces with the Aka pygmies in the great forest of the Congo Basin to come to the aid of this endearing animal, the last vestige of prehistoric times.

programme.title: Top Talent
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival. Strawberry and Cherry are going to sing a duet, Orange is going to juggle, Plum will perform a ballet, Blueberry is writing and directing a play that the Berrykins will perform, Lemon will design animal-shaped hairstyles and display them herself, Princess Berrykin is going to yodel, and Berrykin Bloom will to do a stand-up comedy routine. programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

She insists it's no big deal, but once she heals and tries to resume practice, the usually fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! With the help of her Friends, she tries hard to overcome her fear, but her nightmarish visions of snowboard monsters and jeering snowmen have her shaking in her bed. programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Doby & Disy: Exploring Journey

programme.title: Hogie the Globehopper

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Counting With Paula

Every day is a new adventure, and Stella and Sam share the joy of discovering that they have what it takes to face the biggest adventure of all... growing up.

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Heroes of Envell
programme.desc: Present days. Saint Petersburg. Four friends – Art, Kira, Phil and Vic are the coolest gamers in school. Eventually they find a suspicious laptop with «Heroes of Envell» game installed on it. Turns out that this very laptop is a portal to another dimension, a game realm which is full of adventures and real-life danger. The game realm is a blend of medieval, steampunk and futurism. You never know what really awaits our heroes. Just like the design of the game, the game logic is very unpredictable. You start with a quest and then it becomes a race right until it all grows into a tricky brainteaser. But be sure about one thing – there is no boring or easy way in here. programme.title: Across the River and Into the Trees
programme.desc: Richard Cantwell es un coronel del ejército estadounidense, atormentado por la guerra, que se enfrenta a la noticia de que padece una enfermedad terminal con estoica indiferencia. Un encuentro casual con una joven revive en él la esperanza.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Una familia numerosa
programme.desc: David Wozniak es un hombre de pocas ambiciones cuya vacía existencia da un vuelco cuando descubre que es padre de 533 hijos, fruto de las donaciones de esperma que realizó más de veinte años atrás y que 142 de ellos quieren conocerlo.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Nueve meses
programme.desc: Samuel y su novia Rebecca son una pareja feliz que disfruta una vida acomodada, aunque ella entiende que deben casarse y tener hijos para completar su familia Pero cuando Rebecca queda embarazada, la reacción de Samuel no es la esperada.

programme.title: Blancanieves y el cazador
programme.desc: El Cazador, contratado para matar a Blancanieves, se rehúsa y, en un interesante giro, la entrena para derrotar a la Reina Malvada Descubre esta intensa aventura que lleva al tradicional cuento de hadas a una atmósfera épica.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Un Viaje de Diez Metros
programme.desc: Los Kadam, una familia india, se trasladan al sur de Francia y abren un restaurante, empezando así una intensa rivalidad con el restaurante de enfrente: uno mucho más lujoso, de alta cocina francesa y con estrellas Michelín.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Un equipo milagroso
programme.desc: Caroline Line Found es la jugadora estrella y capitana del equipo de voleibol del instituto West de Iowa City, Iowa. Su trágica muerte en un accidente inspira al entrenador y a las compañeras de equipo a unirse para intentar ganar el campeonato.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: El exótico Hotel Marigold
programme.desc: Un grupo de ancianos ingleses decide disfrutar de su jubilación en Bangalore, una exótica población de la India, pero las diferencias culturales se pondrán de manifiesto y les crearán todo tipo de problemas.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: El exótico Hotel Marigold 2
programme.desc: El exótico Hotel Marigold es el sueño expansionista de Sonny, y le está reclamando más tiempo del que él dispone, considerando su inminente matrimonio con el amor de su vida, Sunaina.

programme.desc: Interviews with Quentin Tarantino and the casts of "Once Upon a Time...in Hollywood” and “The Hateful Eight.”.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: After visiting their late mother’s grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and soon, a shadowy figure begins stalking them. What starts as eerie noises and fleeting glimpses escalates into a night of terror as the sisters are trapped inside their home with a cunning intruder who has cut off all escape.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: The Last Eyewitness
programme.desc: After a violent money exchange in a remote forest leaves several people dead, Riley becomes the only witness to a ruthless crime boss's return. Hunted through the wilderness, she must outlast her pursuers to survive.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Tiffany the Doll
programme.desc: She's the perfect partner, she can fulfill your every fantasy, and she's all yours for a price. The newest toy, Tiffany, is no ordinary sex doll, but you have to play to find out.

programme.title: Restraining Order
programme.desc: A married woman of 10 years, longs for a life of luxury and opulence. An old flame begins to catch her eye as a means to fulfill that dream, at the cost of her jealous husband. He begins to cause a storm of terror, where she fears for her safety.

programme.title: Tilt
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: After visiting their late mother’s grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and soon, a shadowy figure begins stalking them. What starts as eerie noises and fleeting glimpses escalates into a night of terror as the sisters are trapped inside their home with a cunning intruder who has cut off all escape.

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: To Live and Die in DC
programme.desc: Lance Hill sticks to the street code of DC and is admired by those who crave fast money, who put risk over reward. It's his turn to tell his story... If he lives.

programme.title: Induced
programme.desc: An expectant couple heads to a remote cabin to have a natural childbirth, but comes under attack from a predatory midwife who will stop at nothing to snatch their unborn child from them.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: Back and Forth
programme.desc: Pier and Jade found love though the emotions of skating. Love was built but trust was lost, as deep secrets unfold, back and forth between the UK and USA. Having her heart broken, Jade took her fate in her own hands. It was only a matter of time, that the only plan left was to take revenge.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: As the latest successes and failures come and go Mars continues to give up her secrets. Invisible clouds are revealed with ultraviolet light and the search for the source of methane continues with ExoMars. As we prepare to land humans on the red planet, getting there is one thing; staying long term is another, can we really conquor this planet.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space. We humans cannot yet travel that sort of distance, however w e can and do send our robots and probes in our place; and the results are astounding.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15, 000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: Nordkapp

programme.title: 30.000 Miles to the Finish / 30.000 Miglia al Traguardo
programme.desc: Francesco Cappelletti is on the verge of fulfilling a lifelong dream. He'll go head-to-head against some of the biggest names in solo sailing along a 30,000-mile race course in some of the world's most treacherous waters.

programme.title: Inside My Borders 2
programme.desc: The Magna via Francigena has always been an important artery of communication between the north and the south of Sicily, between Palermo and Agrigento and was used by the Romans as early as the second century BC. A spectacular itinerary of 187 km long which crosses mountains, prairies, forests and medieval villages. Michele Sanna decided to walk it at the end of may 2021, when the restrictions due to the Covid pandemic still discouraged people to travel abroad.

programme.title: Date with Nature Season 4 Episode 4
programme.desc: Date with Nature is a serene, anti-stress TV series designed to calm the mind and inspire a sense of balance and peace. Season Four, The Music of Nature, features 10 breathtaking new episodes, showcasing stunning landscapes and immersive natural stories captured by the teams at Living Nature HD and HOME 4K.

programme.title: My Mountain
programme.desc: For children and young people forced into delicate treatments and long hospitalizations, distance learning is not a choice or an emergency solution. It is the only possibility to guarantee education and the opportunity of growth and training for their future. Better yet, it is a mere resemblance of normality in a situation that has nothing normal, between anguish and therapies, doctors and closed rooms where their friends cannot enter.

programme.title: The Invisible Path / Il Sentiero Invisibile
programme.desc: To get out of a dark period, a young musician and a group of boys with drug and alcohol addiction problems approach the mountains, discovering new inner paths. Eleonora is 17 years old and has a wonderful talent for the cello. She has to prepare for an event that will take her to the Musica sulle Apuane festival and that perhaps will change her life.

programme.desc: Eighty-seven years after the first recorded mountaineering ascent in the Sarca Valley, this film reflects on the rich climbing history of its walls-now a magnet for enthusiasts worldwide. Through gripping climbing footage and in-depth interviews with key figures, set against the valley's breathtaking landscape, the story unfolds as a dynamic blend of traditional mountaineering and modern sport climbing.

programme.title: A Year of Upper Michigan Scenery
programme.desc: Take a visual journey through every month of the year in Michigan's beautiful hidden gem, the Upper Peninsula. The scenery of this remote landscape on the shores of Lake Superior is unknown and unlike anywhere else in the world. A Year of Upper Michigan Scenery is the culmination of 8 years of exploring and filming the wilderness of Michigan's Upper Peninsula.

programme.title: Surrender to the Wild / S'abandonner au Sauvage
programme.desc: S'abandonner au Sauvage (Surrender to the Wild) is an adventure in total autonomy without any canoeing experience: 25 days on the water over 500km of wild river. A return to the rhythm of nature, in the boreal forest of the Canadian Far North. Official Selection 2023: Festival Objectif Aventure. Official Selections 2021: Cimalpes, Terre Sauvage Festival. Official Selection 2019: Kendal Mountain Festival. Official Selections 2018: FICMUS, MFHF.

programme.title: Mindsurf
programme.desc: Mindsurf explores how surfing, mindfulness, and psychotherapy intersect to create powerful tools for healing and self-discovery. The film follows groups of women as they take part in intimate encounter sessions sharing personal stories, practicing mindfulness and learning to surf. Through this unique journey, Mindsurf reveals the empowering impact of connecting body and mind in the pursuit of emotional well-being.

programme.title: From Zero to Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: Is it possible to climb a 6,000 metres mountain in just one day, starting from the sea level? The italian ultra-athlete Nico Valsesia answered to this question beating three records of the "From Zero To..." series (Mont Blanc, Aconcagua, Elbrus). In the early summer of 2017 Nico lands in Tanzania to attempt his 4th record: climb Mount Kilimanjaro starting by bicycle from the Indian Ocean coast.

programme.title: Mozart : symphonie No 38, K. 504

L'une des caractéristiques les plus étonnantes de cette symphonie est qu'elle est composée de seulement trois mouvements, ce qui en fait la seule œuvre symphonique majeure de la période classique sans menuet ni scherzo.

programme.title: In der Probe: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: Der finnische Komponist und Dirigent Esa-Pekka Salonen war von 1992 bis 2009 Musikdirektor des Los Angeles Philharmonic. Unter seiner dynamischen Leitung wurde das Orchester als eines der herausragendsten der Welt anerkannt. Die spannende musikalische Partnerschaft, die Salonen mit seinen Musikern aufgebaut hat, wurde in der internationalen Presse weithin gelobt. Die Klarheit, Effizienz und Bescheidenheit des Dirigenten haben eine entspannte Zusammenarbeit zwischen ihm und dem Orchester gefördert, die sich besonders im Probenprozess zeigt. Diese Episode "In Rehearsal" zeigt Salonen bei der Probe von Claude Debussys impressionistischem Orchesterwerk La Mer mit dem Los Angeles Philharmonic im Dorothy Chandler Pavilion des Musikzentrums des Los Angeles County. Sie bietet einen faszinierenden Einblick in Salonens Verhältnis zu seinen Musikern und auch in Debussys Meisterwerk. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La víctima había ingerido una gran cantidad de cianuro. Una pista muy improbable: una falla en el sobre de correo, expuso a un asesino que estaba dispuesto a matar a gente inocente.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1993, Kathryn Bishop de 82 años es encontrada muerta en su hogar de Pennsylvania. Pequeñas pistas en el cuerpo de la víctima le dirán a la policía lo que pasó esa noche.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un oficial de policía de Alaska encontró el cuerpo de una mujer mientras patrullaba de rutina un parque público.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2008, la respuesta de emergencia de Illinois atendió un incendio en un garaje y se encontró a un hombre aplastado debajo de un camión.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Nicole Rae Walker, de 6 años de edad, murió en un choque donde el culpable se dio a la fuga en su Vecindario de Ft. Lauderdale.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1999, Susan Fassett fue abatida a tiros cuando salía de su práctica de coro de la iglesia en Poughkeepsie, Nueva York. Su esposo Jeff se convirtió en el principal sospechoso, hasta que fue absuelto por la policía.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las vacaciones familiares se convierten en una pesadilla cuando a una mujer la encuentran boca abajo en un lago.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En las primeras horas de la mañana, justo antes de Navidad, una estudiante universitaria fue secuestrada del estacionamiento de su departamento. Su cuerpo fue encontrado más tarde ese día. Ella había sido agredida sexualmente y fue disparada a quemarropa.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Testigo presencial
programme.desc: Una adolescente desapareció después de una noche de paseos a caballo. Su cuerpo fue encontrado un mes después, a cinco kilómetros de su casa.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1989, los cadáveres de Joan Rogers y sus dos hijas adolescentes fueron encontrados flotando en la Bahía de Tampa.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una niña de 13 años desapareció de su casa en Colorado y la única evidencia que dejó el secuestrador fueron tres huellas digitales en la cortina de una ventana.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: La pista ardiente
programme.desc: Un pirómano en serie anda suelto en Washington, DC. Cada uno de los incendios se inició con el mismo tipo de dispositivo incendiario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Avis Banks y su hijo no nacido fueron brutalmente asesinados. El cuerpo fue descubierto por su prometido Keyon Pittman. La policía se enteró de que Pittman estaba teniendo aventuras con otras mujeres y se convirtió en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1990, el cuerpo de Shirley Andronowich fue encontrado mutilado. Los testigos le dijeron a la policía que tuvo una pelea con su esposo la noche anterior, pero la evidencia forense demostró que él no tuvo nada que ver con su muerte.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2005, el cuerpo de la joven madre, Summer Baldwin, fue encontrado en una maleta en un vertedero de Texas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las cámaras de seguridad en un casino rastrearon los movimientos de una joven poco antes de que desapareciera. Nunca se le volvió a ver, pero a través de la evidencia que dejó, pudo decírsele a los investigadores qué le sucedió y quién fue el responsable.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer de 19 años fue encontrada muerta en su automóvil; la escena se había organizado para que el asesinato pareciera un suicidio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1984, el cuerpo de la universitaria Laura Salmon fue encontrado en una granja de Tennessee, cubierto con sus propios jeans y los jeans del asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Intrusión bienvenida
programme.desc: Un hombre le dice a la policía que le disparó a un intruso que había atacado y asesinado a su esposa. El marido pinta un cuadro trágico y es apodado héroe.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asesinato brutal, muchos sospechosos y pruebas contradictorias, pero los forenses fueron claros en una cosa: el asesino conocía a su víctima. Y eso les dio a los investigadores una ventaja.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1985, Julie Estes fue secuestrada de una tienda de conveniencia en Southside donde trabajaba. Su cuerpo fue encontrado al día siguiente, pero el asesinato quedó sin resolver hasta el 2003.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1981, Cassie Hansen, de 6 años, desapareció de su iglesia de Minnesota durante una misa vespertina. Después de recibir un aviso de que se vio a un hombre mayor cargando a una persona pequeña, la policía encontró el cuerpo de Cassie en un basurero.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La mejora digital del video de la cámara de seguridad muestra que lo que parece ser un encuentro casual es en realidad un secuestro forzado, que conduce al asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerta a Wanda Mason, empleada de una tienda, los investigadores descubren que la cámara de seguridad de la tienda ha captado todo el asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Una Bolsa de Evidencia
programme.desc: Se investiga el asesinato de Jessica Knott, de 9 años. Los investigadores usan una bolsa de basura para conectar al sospechoso James Edward Crow, Jr. con el crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Noticia de última hora
programme.desc: Una joven productora de noticias de televisión es violada y asesinada en su apartamento. La policía identifica a dos sospechosos, pero ambos son absueltos de cualquier delito.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una niña de doce años reclama que ha sido secuestrada y abusada sexualmente. Ella contó lo que había pasado con voz calma, sin alteraciones ni emociones, lo que hizo difícil que la policía le creyera.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: A medida que cambia la marea
programme.desc: La mujer estaba muerta. Al hombre le habían disparado cuatro veces pero sobrevivió.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer de 19 años fue encontrada muerta en su automóvil; la escena se había organizado para que el asesinato pareciera un suicidio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un joven bombero murió de lo que parecía ser una enfermedad cardíaca grave pero no diagnosticada, su familia y amigos quedaron devastados, pero no tenían pruebas de algún juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Todo lo que brilla no es oro
programme.desc: La policía descubre un carro agujereado de balas, un conductor extraviado y ningún testigo. ¿Será que la víctima fue raptada o ha sido asesinada?

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2003, Kathy Lorick fue asesinada en una pista de carreras en Concord, California, en pleno día, mientras hablaba con su esposo por su teléfono móvil.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, más de una docena de niños en Seattle, Washington, luchaban por sus vidas. Cada uno de ellos había contraído una enfermedad grave desconocida. Después de que uno murió, los investigadores sabían que el reloj estaba corriendo.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Catherine, Nick y Sara investigan un cadáver aparentemente de hace meses encontrado en las montañas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Catherine investigan a un espectador de cine que fue apuñalado hasta la muerte

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Catherine investigan el asesinato de un cómico despreciado que murió en el escenario, al parecer tras beber de una botella de agua contaminada.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom, Catherine y Nick investigan la muerte de una domadora atropellada por su caballo a bordo de un jet privado. Sara y Warrick investigan un escenario de Romeo y Julieta en el desierto.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom, Sara y Nick investigan el asesinato de una mujer en el palco de prensa del estadio de un instituto.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un atraco profesional a un banco provoca la muerte de un detective. Mientras investiga el caso, Grissom se enfrenta a su pérdida de audición y otro CSI recibe una revelación personal.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Dos parejas se encuentran en un bar y una de ellas es asesinada. Cuando una segunda pareja es asesinada de forma similar, el equipo sospecha que una pareja de asesinos en serie anda suelta.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Cuando los principales sospechosos del caso del asesino en serie de Grissom son asesinados, Grissom sospecha que se trata de un trabajo desde dentro.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Warrick se ocupan del caso de una anciana encontrada momificada en su armario. Sara y Nick llegan a investigar un allanamiento de morada para encontrar a una adolescente violada.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Durante la última ola de calor de Las Vegas, con temperaturas de tres dígitos, Gil y Catherine investigan a un bebé encerrado en un coche.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El equipo se introduce en el lado Furry de Las Vegas cuando un hombre es encontrado muerto a un lado de la carretera, vestido con un traje de mapache.

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: La comparecencia de Warrick en la vista preliminar de un caso de violación y asesinato sale terriblemente mal cuando la única prueba es desestimada por un tecnicismo.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El encaprichamiento de un sospechoso con Catherine hace que ésta se haga cargo de un caso de alto perfil.

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: För första gången hålls uttagningarna till Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders i den magnifika Cowboys Stadium i Arlington i Texas. Över 600 aspiranter med drömmar om att komma med i 2010-2011 års DCC-trupp anländer före gryningen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: De 47 nya tjejerna som tog sig till slututtagningen har haft två veckor på sig att träna, men kan de mäta sig med de 27 återvändande DCC-veteranerna?

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: DCC:s träningsläger börjar i kväll! Träningslägeraspiranterna anländer till Valley Ranch för första gången och får en chans att träffa sina idoler och mentorer - DCC-veteranerna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Det är andra veckan och snart ska de första skickas hem. Några utvalda veteraner skickas för att spela in ett inslag för "Good Morning America" och de får en livslång dröm att slå in för en lycklig kvinna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Vecka fyra av träningslägret börjar med att nybörjarna får deras DCC-makeover. Allt från hår och smink till solbrännor och tandblekning används för att göra kandidaterna DCC-redo.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Träningslägret börjar lida mot sitt slut och det är dags för fotografering. Träningslägerkandidater och veteraner gör sig redo för närbilder i deras figursydda DCC-uniformer, med perfekt hår och smink.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: 2010 års trupp för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders måste kungöras inom två dagar. Det är ingen hemlighet att det är sista chansen och pressen på träningslägerkandidaterna är enorm. Det är dags att visa framfötterna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Trettiofyra nya kandidater och veteraner klär sig inför det officiella truppfotot. Men det faktum att chefen och koreografen för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders fortfarande inte har tillkännagett 2010 års trupp lägger sordin på stämningen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Audition Begins
programme.desc: Cowboys Stadium i Arlington i Texas är återigen skådeplats för uttagningarna till Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. 500 kandidater som drömmer om en plats i teamet för säsongen 2011-2012 kommer till kvalet i gryningen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: On the Field
programme.desc: På den magnifika Cowboys Stadium äger DCC-uttagningen rum. Det blir spänt hos de 69 nya tjejerna när de 18 DCC-veteranerna ger sig in i kampen om en inbjudan till träningslägret.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Training Camp
programme.desc: DCC-träningslägret börjar ikväll på Valley Ranch! Stressen hos de nya kandidaterna är påtaglig när de försöker stuva om i sina scheman och säkra nya boenden i Dallas.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Famous Uniform
programme.desc: Efter två veckors träning förbereder sig Kelli och Judy inför första gallringen. Veckans repetitioner är viktiga för alla tjejer, de förväntas bemästra DCC:s världsberömda 'kick line' och 'jump split'.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Efter tre veckors träning kallas färskingarna in för sin DCC-'makeover'. De får en ny look, frisyrer och smink, och stöps i DCC-mallen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Cameo Photos
programme.desc: Kvällens repetition börjar med en knall när DCC:s tekniska chef Kitty Carter överraskar med ett besök på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Field Rehearsal
programme.desc: Det är två veckor kvar till första matchen och Kelli McGonagill Finglass och Judy Trammel måste snart göra de sista gallringarna och presentera truppen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Finale
programme.desc: Allt ska avgöras den sista träningskvällen. Ikväll går drömmar i uppfyllelse, eller i kras. Kelli överraskar tjejerna genom att ta med dem till lagets träningsplan, för att se dem prestera.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Preliminary Auditions
programme.desc: I denna två timmar långa säsongpremiär av Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team kommer 600 hoppfulla kandidater till Cowboys Stadium för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders preliminära uttagningar.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Training Camp
programme.desc: Träningslägret börjar och många av de nya kandidaterna har behövt bryta upp och flytta till Dallas utan garanti för att de klarar lägret och blir en Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader .

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Jump Split
programme.desc: Det är bara andra repetitionsveckan och Kelli och Judy är snabba med att gå igenom DCC-rörelserna med kandidaterna. Många av de nya kandidaterna har aldrig gjort ett spagathopp och deras brist på erfarenhet gör att några av flickorna skadar sig.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeover
programme.desc: Det är fjärde träningsveckan och utmanarna får en DCC-makeover. Under Kelli Finglass överinseende får tjejerna DCC-looken med nya frisyrer och och ny sminkning.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Week Five
programme.desc: Det är femte träningsveckan och Kelli är borta på grund av sjukdom. DCC:s tekniska ledare, Kitty Carter, hoppar in och leder veckans första repetition. Kitty är brutalt ärlig när hon påpekar att flera av tjejerna dansar slarvigt.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Final Cuts
programme.desc: Träningslägrets sjunde vecka börjar med en repetition på planen på Cowboys Stadium. Kelli och Judy är redo att göra de sista uttagningarna och kvällens repetition kan avgöra vilka som går vidare till truppen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Announcing the Squad
programme.desc: Det är dags att tillkännage DCC-truppen men först ser Kelli och Judy till att det blir en sista repetition ute på plan på Cowboys Stadium för kandidaterna. Tjejerna känner av pressen och Kelli och Judy har koll på dem.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Pacte mortel
programme.desc: En 1990 et en 1991, la police de Chicago et le FBI sont sur la piste d’un voleur de banques dont les crimes sont de plus en plus violents. L’auteur de ces vols utilise toujours des voitures japonaises pour s’enfuir.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Une inconnue dans la ville
programme.desc: La découverte du corps d’une jeune femme au bord d’une autoroute près d’une petite ville de Pennsylvanie plonge la police locale dans le désarroi. On se tourne bientôt vers le FBI pour demander de l’aide.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Proie humaine
programme.desc: Au sud de l’Ohio, Thomas Dillon tue cinq randonneurs en 3 ans. Une information permet aux agents du FBI de mettre la main sur une arme à feu et de démontrer, par le biais d’une analyse ballistique, qu’il s’agit de l’arme du crime.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: État d’alerte
programme.desc: En 1984, le viol et le meurtre de 10 femmes près de Tampa en Floride met la police et la population en état d’alerte. Les experts du FBI, qui analysent les indices recueillis sur les scènes du crime, découvrent bientôt un point commun entre ces cas.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Enjeux élevés
programme.desc: À la Nouvelle-Orléans, après qu’un criminel de carrière eut commis un meurtre depuis sa voiture, des agents du FBI le traquent grâce à ses habitudes et sa dépendance au jeu. Ils concentrent leur enquête sur les casinos éparpillés dans le comté.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Sur les traces d’un meurtrier
programme.desc: À l’été 1999, le Texas est aux prises avec un cruel tueur en série qui se déplace en train. Le FBI met sur pied un groupe d’intervention pour recueillir des informations sur ce dangereux travailleur saisonner.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Évasion meurtrière
programme.desc: En Alabama, deux criminels reconnus échappent à leur gardien et prennent la fuite. Ils évitent les autorités en se déplaçant d’État en État et n’hésitent pas à enlever des individus pour leur voler leur voiture.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Secret fatal
programme.desc: En 1992, une jeune mère est abattue devant ses enfants. Les policiers cherchent des réponses, mais en vain. Ce meurtre cruel semble gratuit. Des proches de la victime fournissent alors un indice troublant aux enquêteurs.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: L’attentat à la bombe du World Trade Center
programme.sub-title: L’attentat à la bombe du World Trade Center
programme.desc: Le 26 février 1993, à New York, le stationnement du World Trade Center est le théâtre d’une explosion qui coûte la vie à 6 personnes et en blesse des milliers d’autres. La détonation a causé une brèche d’une hauteur de 5 étages.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: L’enlèvement de Polly Klaas
programme.desc: Le 1er octobre 1993, Polly Klaas, 12 ans, est enlevée chez elle par un inconnu lors d’une fête organisée pour elle et ses amies. La police fait immédiatement appel au FBI. Des analystes recueillent des fibres dans sa chambre à coucher.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Démantèlement
programme.desc: Dans les années 80, le service de police de New York mène une lutte perdue d’avance contre les narcotrafiquants. Les gangs qui vendent de la drogue empochent des millions de dollars et ils sont prêts à tout pour protéger leurs acquis.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Opération Shattered Shield
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le service de police de la Nouvelle-Orléans est aux prises avec une importante affaire de corruption. Certains policiers n’hésitent pas à tuer pour protéger leurs profits.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Une entrée forcée
programme.desc: 1994, la région métropolitaine de Detroit est aux prises avec des cas d’entrées par effraction et de vols. Les voleurs appartiennent à un groupe dont les crimes s’étendent de fraude d’assurances et de vol de voitures à des rackets de loteries illégales.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Paiment final
programme.desc: En 1980, des criminels laissent une bombe de 500 kilos dans un casino du Nevada et exigent la somme d’un million de dollars pour la désamorcer. C’est la plus grosse bombe que le FBI ait jamais vue.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Résistance extrême
programme.desc: En 1970, Otpor, un violent mouvement de résistance croate, commet des actes terroristes contre les Croates vivant aux États-Unis et ne soutenant pas leur cause.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: À l’abri de la loi
programme.desc: En Californie, l’agent de police George Gwaltney découvre le corps de Robin Bishop, 23 ans, assassinée près de sa voiture sur une route isolée. Gwaltney déclare qu’il est innocent et il est acquitté à deux reprises mais.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Un instinct de tueur
programme.desc: À Washington, une enseignante est abattue au moment où elle monte dans sa voiture. Le meurtrier laisse son corps dans le stationnement et s’enfuit avec son véhicule.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Poursuite internationale
programme.desc: À Langley en Virginie, un homme abat des individus en pleine heure de pointe. Le meurtre d’employés de la CIA met la population des États-Unis en état de choc.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Confiance absolue
programme.desc: En 1988, on fait la lumière sur la mort mystérieuse d’un fermier de la Caroline du Sud quand un criminel reconnaît avoir été engagé par deux importants membres de la communauté pour commettre ce meurtre.

Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).
